items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: And so they had a new way, a style of interpreting music, presenting it. Sometimes I know it would go down, and then come up, and then down again, et cetera. You had new ways of punctuating notes. That’s why it was such a dynamic band. It was these uh what you’d call “innovations” were, were rampant.
Who were some of the other people in the, in the orchestra at that time?
Oh there was uh Joe Gayles, the other tenor player, Ernie Henry...
